The constructor-paired base vtables retain preRenderUpdate at slot 22. The derived slot 22 method calls the base routine at the recorded E8 witness

Pre-render reads the screen clock pointer at +0xb0 versus +0xa8, then compares its current float against the adjacent last-time field. Positive delta stores move from camera+0x400/+0x404 to +0x3f8/+0x3fc; the zero/negative branch still retains the previous native delta
The current pre-render stack changes from 0xe8 to 0xf8; a changed RVA alone would fail the original fixed prologue gate
